text:
Antioxidants are molecules that help protect cells from damage caused by unstable molecules known as free radicals. Free radicals can build up in the body and cause oxidative stress, which is linked to chronic diseases such as heart disease, cancer, and diabetes. By neutralizing these free radicals, antioxidants offer several health benefits, including reducing inflammation, supporting the immune system, and potentially lowering the risk of certain chronic conditions.

Regarding the priority question, the transparent material commonly used to make windows is glass.
